node.title: Re: rel2abs of a path with tilde (updated)
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
I have a bunch of paths and for each path I want to convert it from relative path to absolute path.

Have a look at [mod://Path::ExpandTilde]. Note that the resulting path will be dependent on the system this function is being run on and the current username.

Update: Note the docs of [doc://File::Spec]'s rel2abs: "No checks against the filesystem are made." But if you don't mind going out to the filesystem, you can also use [doc://Cwd]'s abs_path.
